dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, following a smooth convex-to-linear gradient.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Distinct asymmetrical protrusion on the left lateral margin relative to the central axis; the right margin exhibits a more uniform and streamlined convex curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; characterized by uniform high-intensity pixel values across the visible dorsal area with negligible gray-scale variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Transverse indentation visible at the nuchal region immediately posterior to the blowhole, creating a localized shadow-casting disruption.

other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a localized, high-contrast dark-pixel aperture at the anterior terminus.
